title: AGENT-CLI.md frontmatter — agentcli-interactive/v1
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter of an AIP-45 AGENT-CLI.md manifest. Sibling of AIP-29 (CLI.md, tool CLIs); covers interactive agent CLIs (Hermes, Claude Code, OpenCode, Goose, Gemini CLI). Shares install/version/auth blocks with AIP-29 via $ref; binds to AIP-44 ACP for the wire protocol when protocol=acp.

name.description: Kebab id, MUST equal the parent directory name.

bin.description: Path to the binary (absolute or PATH-resolvable).

env.description: Static environment variables always merged into the spawn env, before any mode/option env patch (so those can override). Always-on counterpart to modes[].env / options[].env. Primary user is a generic ACP agent whose whole config surface is bin + args + env.

install.description: Install methods — shared with AIP-29 via $ref.

setup.description: Post-install configuration steps — shared with AIP-29 via $ref. Used for sidecar daemons (openclaw onboard) and one-time bind config (gateway URL, default channel) that don't fit the auth state machine.

sandbox.description: Inherits AIP-36 SANDBOX.md verbatim. Either an inline block or a workspace-relative ref to a SANDBOX.md.

protocol.description: Wire protocol discriminator. acp = AIP-44 ACP server; mcp = MCP-over-stdio; proprietary = adapter package implements AgentCliClient.

acp.description: Workspace-relative ref to an AIP-44 ACP.md describing the wire profile. REQUIRED when protocol=acp.

mcp.description: MCP server config. REQUIRED when protocol=mcp.

adapter.description: NPM package name implementing AgentCliClient. REQUIRED when protocol=proprietary.

modes.description: Mutually-exclusive operation modes the CLI exposes. The host picks at most one per turn via OPERATOR.runtime.config.mode. Each mode patches bin_args / env; the patches are applied AFTER the manifest's default bin_args and BEFORE option patches. Common shape: claude-code's permission modes (default | plan | accept-edits | bypass-permissions).

options.description: Independent typed knobs the CLI accepts. The host picks any subset per turn via OPERATOR.runtime.config.options. Patches apply in declaration order, AFTER mode patches.

presets.description: AIP-45 gateway presets this adapter can drive (Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible backends). Merged into the provider-preset catalog (agentproto presets list / list_provider_presets) alongside the built-in registry, deduped by id (built-in wins on collision). Lets an external adapter surface a gateway the built-in registry doesn't know about.

mode.description: ephemeral = torn down on disconnect; persistent = survives reconnect within idle_timeout_ms; resumable = durable across runs (requires capabilities.resumable: true).

models.description: Model routing for the agent. Maps logical defaults to env var slots resolved via AIP-19 SECRETS.md.

default.description: Default model id passed to the agent.

oneOf.description: A model id annotated with who serves/bills it and how this adapter reaches it. A bare string (still legal) leaves provider unstated — the projector MUST NOT guess one.

id.description: Model id, unchanged on the wire — this is annotation, not renaming.

provider.description: ProviderPreset id (or direct provider, e.g. "anthropic") — who serves and bills this model. Omit when unstated.

mode.description: This adapter's mode id that routes to `provider` (e.g. "moonshot"). Omit when the adapter routes on its own (e.g. a model-id prefix) or needs no mode switch.

allowed.description: Model ids the host MAY route to. Each entry is either a bare id (provider unstated, adapter default) or a { id, provider?, mode? } binding declaring who serves it and which adapter mode reaches it.

env.description: Map of model slot -> env var name (e.g. anthropic -> ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).

capabilities.description: Manifest-declared capabilities. When protocol=acp, MUST be a subset of the AIP-44 ACP.md capabilities the bound runtime negotiates.

mode.description: A single mutually-exclusive operation mode. Exactly one mode is active per turn; modes do not stack. Use options for independent knobs.

id.description: Stable id. The operator config references this id.

kind.description: Which orthogonal session-config axis this mode expresses. Narrowed to the single value 'context' (what enters context) — the only concern with no ACP-protocol home. Route is derived from the model catalog (@route route-identity), not a manifest mode; posture comes from the harness's own ACP mode registry (SessionModeState.availableModes). Omitted ⇒ inferred from the id. The legacy 'posture'/'route' back-compat classification lives in the daemon's decomposeMode shim, not this manifest surface.

bin_args_prepend.description: Extra argv prepended before the manifest's bin_args when this mode is active.

bin_args_append.description: Extra argv appended after the manifest's bin_args when this mode is active.

env.description: Extra env vars merged into the spawn env when this mode is active.

env_unset.description: Env keys to DELETE from the spawn env when this mode is active. Applied at the runtime's env-merge point after ambient process.env + mode/option env are combined, so a mode can scrub a credential that must never reach a non-native endpoint (e.g. a gateway mode scrubbing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY so it can't leak to a third-party Anthropic-compatible host). Unlike `env`, deletion is the only safe semantics for scrubbing.

status.description: Honest support status surfaced to clients. active = does what its description claims; noop = declared and accepted but measured to have no effect; planned = declared surface not wired yet. Absent ⇒ treated as active.

status_note.description: Human-readable reason backing `status` (e.g. what was measured).

option.description: A single typed knob. Multiple options can be active in the same turn; each option's patch is independent.

id.description: Stable id. The operator config references this id.

default.description: Default value used when the operator config omits this option. Type matches the declared `type`.

bin_args_prepend.description: Argv template prepended before the manifest's bin_args when the option has a non-default value. The literal token `{value}` is replaced with the option's value (stringified).

bin_args_template.description: Argv template appended when the option has a non-default value. The literal token `{value}` is replaced with the option's value (stringified). Use for value-bearing flags like `--model {value}` or `--max-turns {value}`.

bin_args_append_when_true.description: Argv appended when type=boolean AND value=true. Use for bare flags like `--auto`.

env.description: Env vars to merge when the option has a non-default value. Values may contain `{value}` for templating.

env_unset.description: Env keys to DELETE from the spawn env when the option has a non-default value. Symmetric with mode.env_unset and applied at the same runtime env-merge point. Lets a value-bearing option (e.g. base_url pointing at a third-party Anthropic-compatible gateway) scrub the ambient credential (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) it must displace, without forcing the operator to also pick a preset mode.

preset.description: A gateway preset this adapter can drive — a backend an Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible client can front. Declared in the manifest so the catalog surfaces adapter-contributed presets alongside the built-in registry. No adapter projection (env/env_unset/bin_args) here; that stays in modes/options.

id.description: Stable preset id. SHOULD equal the mode id if the adapter projects this preset as a mode. Catalog dedupes built-in vs adapter-declared by id; an adapter-declared id colliding with a built-in is ignored in favor of the built-in (registry is source of truth for canonical providers).

label.description: Human label for the catalog UI.

schemaFlavor.description: API schema flavor — selects which adapter family can consume the preset.

keyEnv.description: Conventional env var holding this provider's API key. Catalog status is derived from its presence in the daemon's environment (ready vs available).

scrubEnv.description: Env vars to scrub when this preset is active. Optional — an adapter that scrubs in code may omit it. Not surfaced to catalog clients.

defaultModel.description: Conventional default model id for this provider, if any.

homepage.description: Optional homepage/docs URL for the catalog UI.

continuation.description: How prior turns reach the CLI. The driver hosts a strategy registry; this block declares which strategies fit this CLI and which is the default. The operator config MAY override `default` with any id from `supported`.

supported.description: Strategies the CLI is known to work with. The host MUST refuse to run with a strategy outside this list.

pinned_session.description: Tuning for the pinned-session strategy. Ignored by other strategies.

idle_timeout_ms.description: How long an idle pinned session is kept alive before the driver closes it. Applies in addition to the CLI's own session.idle_timeout_ms.

key_scope.description: Composite key that uniquely identifies a pinned session. Default keys by (conversation, operator) — different conversations get different child processes; one operator per conversation reuses one process across turns.

continuationStrategyId.description: Built-in strategy ids. Future custom strategies require a follow-up AIP that opens this enum.
